annotations.title: Undo a Google Ads rule run

description: Put back what one live run changed (the latest by default, or runId). A change is reverted only if the object still holds the value the run gave it; anything changed since is left alone and named. If putting things back would RAISE spend (re-enabling, restoring a higher budget) it needs confirm:true. Does not switch the rule off. Free.

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

runId.description: from google_ads_rule_history; default the latest live run with changes

name: undo_google_ads_rule_action
title: Undo a Google Ads rule run
